result: Original GEP008 C01-C03 candidate acceptance qualified within declared profiles; source publication and revised frontend delivery/readback pending.

scope.profile: MapLibre loaded-scene captured raster pages and observed Linux desktop controls

originalAcceptanceCriteria: Users save PNG/JPEG and print/PDF views at declared resolutions with title, description, legend, compass, scale, attribution, and selected feature descriptions.
2D and 3D camera framing, layer order, labels, overlays, historical date, and imagery attribution reproduce in the exported artifact.
Independent visual comparison covers representative layouts, accessibility, color, text, high DPI, and cancellation/error behavior.
contract.limits: MapLibre captured output:8 layouts/Project,2 map frames/layout,32KiB saved layouts;96/150/300DPI,20M pixels/page/frame,8MiB/frame PNG,32MiB figure ZIP,1MiB context/64KiB manifest;8 text blocks/layout,4000 characters each,40 legend rows.3D compass/scale/grid omitted with visible notice. Source publication and revised frontend delivery/readback pending.

acceptedBehavior: Annotated PNG/JPEG/raster PDF/SVG/HTML/ZIP preserve title, description/selected-feature text, legend, valid compass/scale, credits and exact capture/source bindings.
Saved2D/3D camera, Layer order/labels and frame basemap/date/imagery attribution restore after main-Project changes. Stale captures refuse; templates use destination scene.
Normal-owner UI CAS saves and fresh archived server/UI read prove saved-frame restoration/recapture. Real-source authored text and synthetic selected-description extraction remain distinct.
Exact-source local fit yields visible frame/PNG/JPEG/PDF pixels; fitted camera was not owner-saved.
Independent native rendered-scene/Save Image PREVIEW comparison covers representative layouts, controls/keyboard, contrast/text, physical DPI and cancellation/errors.
limitations: Map/PDF frames are captured raster; PDF embeds JPEG without selectable/georeferenced content.3D compass/scale/grid are visibly omitted; only MapLibre capture accepted.

Output DPI rerenders loaded vectors but adds no finer upstream raster/terrain data. Letterboxing preserves the captured viewport. System-font metrics may differ; supplied raster formats retain fixed pixels. Arbitrary authored Styles, scripts/fonts/devices and full WCAG/tagged-PDF conformance are not claimed.
Owner date proof uses blank basemap/disabled imagery; active date/credits use controlled-source checks, without new provider reconstruction or freshness proof.

Google Earth Pro7.3.7.1327 comparison uses rendered Save Image preview/controls. Final native modal dispatch is uncertain; no native file/custom annotation equivalence claimed; native service usage uninstrumented.
Source publication and revised frontend delivery/readback pending; candidate acceptance is not production delivery or whole-product parity.
